summary: BitVec::insert rejected index == len before appending. The fix checks index.saturating_sub(1), allowing insertion at the end of a nonempty vector. The updated doctest in src/vec/api.rs exercises insert(5, true) on five bits, but the prototype runner supports only library and integration tests. The existing vec::tests::misc test inserts in the middle and does not detect this bug. Test selection is blocked by unsupported doctest execution; no tests were run.
